snippet.title: Synergia Next-Gen Edition - Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10001734

At the end of the world, sometimes love is the ultimate crime. Remastered in 4K and native on PS5 for the first time, Synergia Next-Gen edition is a remaster of the acclaimed visual novel, with new features and new content, including an in-game artbook, comic, music room, and the widely anticipated "SUNRISE" expansion.

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games 

Rated Mature
